simple.meaning: עָדָשׁ (ʻâdâsh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a lentil.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 25:34. The surrounding context includes family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָדָשׁ (H5742) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עָדָשׁ (ʻâdâsh) / H5742 is traced through Genesis 25:34, 2 Samuel 17:28, 2 Samuel 23:11, Ezekiel 4:9 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

timeline.evidenceText: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,
After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop, where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

“Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

definitions.full: H5742. adashah [ עֲדָשָׁה ] noun feminine lentile (Late Hebrew עֲדָשָׁה id. ; Löw No. 140 ; Arabic image u%navailable ; on formation see Lag BN 50 ); — plural עֲדָשִׁים growing 2Sam 23:11 ; article of food, 17:28 ; Ezek 4:9 ; ע ׳נְזִיד Gen 25:34 (J) pottage of lentiles . עַוָּא see עַוָּה עוב (√ of following; compare Arabic , be absent, hidden , of sun, set ; hidden place, thicket, wood , so Syriac ; hence obscuring clouds , compare Late Hebrew עָב , Aramaic עִיבָא cloud(s) ).
